Design a comprehensive mocking strategy covering: 1) Which dependencies to mock vs use real implementations, 2) When to use @Mock vs @Spy vs real beans, 3) Handling complex interaction verification (order, frequency, arguments), 4) Dealing with async callbacks and CompletableFuture returns, 5) Testing retry logic with mocks, 6) Verifying error handling paths, 7) Avoiding over-mocking and brittle tests, 8) Balancing test speed vs realism. Include specific examples of stubbing complex scenarios like: external API returning paginated results, cache hit/miss sequences, message publishing with acknowledgments, and transaction rollback behavior.
